high.title: Interest Rate Cooling Down, Expert Points Out 2 Main Impacts on Securities
high.summary: Multiple commercial banks have simultaneously reduced both deposit and lending rates, reversing the upward trend from late 2025. Expert Nguyen Trong Dinh Tam from Thien Viet Securities identifies two key impacts: First, creating positive psychological effects for interest-rate sensitive sectors like real estate, construction, and securities. Second, facilitating capital flows back to the stock market as valuations become more attractive compared to 5-year averages. However, the expert warns this rate reduction may be short-term, and sustained low rates will depend on macroeconomic stability and inflation control. This development is significant for FX traders as lower rates typically weaken VND and could influence SBV's monetary policy stance.

high.title: "Any Dramatic Variable from the World Can Cause VN-Index to Fluctuate Strongly"
high.summary: VN-Index surged nearly 80 points on April 8th driven by three key factors: (1) Government completion with new PM Le Minh Hung targeting 10%+ GDP growth and new SBV Governor directing 0.5-1% rate cuts, (2) FTSE Russell confirming Vietnam's emerging market upgrade in September 2026, and (3) Middle East tensions easing through US-Iran ceasefire reducing oil prices by 15%. The surge created a large gap-up at 1,677-1,705 points. Pinetree Securities analyst Vu Thi Quynh Trang notes the market remains vulnerable to global developments and expects consolidation around 1,750 points as the index tests resistance levels.

high.title: Bank Executive Provides Interest Rate Forecast After Banks' Moves
high.summary: Following SBV Governor Pham Duc An's meeting, multiple banks cut rates significantly. Agribank reduced deposit rates by 0.5% for 24+ month terms (new ceiling: 6% for 24 months, 5.9% for 12-18 months) and lending rates by 0.5%. Nam A Bank also cut both deposit and lending rates by up to 0.5% for 6+ month terms. Bank executives justify these moves as necessary to reduce funding costs and stimulate economic recovery. This coordinated rate cutting cycle signals potential monetary easing by SBV, which could impact VND exchange rates and government bond yields significantly.

high.title: "Tonic" for the Stock Market
high.summary: Mirae Asset Securities' Tran Quoc Toan views rate cuts as direct "tonic" for markets through two channels: First, stock markets become attractive again as deposit rates lose appeal, causing idle funds to shift toward higher-yield assets like equities. Second, lower rates improve corporate profit margins and reduce financing costs. The rate reduction follows SBV Governor Pham Duc An's directive to banks, creating expectations of capital flow redirection from deposits to securities. This monetary easing could significantly impact VND funding costs and alter investment flows between fixed income and equity markets.

medium.title: Many Positive Signals, How Will Securities Perform Next Week?
medium.summary: Experts forecast VN-Index to fluctuate around 1,750 points next week. Foreign investors returned with net buying of 842 billion VND after selling over 2,000 billion VND previously, signaling potential market support. Cautious disbursement recommended, prioritizing sectors with good Q1 results like securities, steel, and banking.

medium.title: Independent Board Member of VPBankS Resigns
medium.summary: VPBank Securities (VPX) announced resignation of independent board member Nguyen Quang Trung due to personal reasons. This follows earlier resignation of Vu Huu Dien in March. VPBankS' AGM scheduled for April 20th with business plan targeting 11,074 billion VND total revenue for 2026.

medium.title: Good News for Vietcombank Users When Traveling
medium.summary: Vietcombank launched cross-border QR payment service through Alipay+ partnership, allowing VCB Digibank app users to pay in 50+ countries including China, South Korea, Singapore. This eliminates currency exchange hassles for Vietnamese travelers, particularly significant for China travel where QR payments dominate retail transactions.

medium.title: Gold Ring and Gold Bar Prices on April 12th
medium.summary: Domestic gold prices remained flat at session opening on April 12th. SJC gold bars priced at 169.7-172.7 million VND/tael across major dealers. International gold closed week at $4,747/ounce, up 1.6% for third consecutive weekly gain following US-Iran ceasefire agreement despite ongoing skepticism about sustainability.

medium.title: Why Diamond Properties "Hesitant" to Sell All Novaland Shares
medium.summary: Diamond Properties, related to Novaland Chairman Bui Thanh Nhon, sold only 930,800 of planned 2.157 million NVL shares (43.15% completion) due to "plan changes." NVL shares have surged 59% since early March lows, reaching 16,800 VND with improving liquidity, potentially explaining the reluctance to complete the full disposal.
